title: “From the north, and from the south” — the Hebrew and the Greek print the word for “sea”
summary: The KJV of Psalm 107:3 ends its list of directions with “from the south”. The pointed Hebrew and Brenton’s Greek print, in that place, the noun that the KJV renders “sea” at Psalm 107:23.

title: “To sit up late” — the Greek has “rise up after sitting”
summary: The KJV of Psalm 127:2 lists, beside rising up early, “to sit up late”. Brenton’s Greek has a verb of rising up after the act of sitting.
